privacy.intro: At EnpiAI, we take your privacy very seriously. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal and health information in accordance with international standards and requirements for platforms like Google Cloud Console. Please note that EnpiAI is an independent SaaS platform and is not affiliated, associated, authorized, or officially endorsed in any way by Herbalife International or Herbalife Nutrition.

collection.title: 1. Information We Collect
collection.content: To provide our AI assistant services and wellness tools, we collect information that you directly provide to us when creating an account, connecting messaging channels (WhatsApp, Telegram), or performing a wellness evaluation.
collection.item1: Account and Profile Data: Name, email address, phone number, distributor level, and Herbalife ID.
collection.item2: Integration Data: Google Calendar OAuth tokens for scheduling synchronization, and credentials for the WhatsApp/Telegram gateway.
collection.item3: Wellness Evaluation Data: Body measurements (weight, height), BMI, blood pressure, pulse, energy level, sleep quality/hours, water intake, meals, and health symptoms voluntarily reported by your prospects.
collection.item4: Knowledge Base Data (RAG): Product catalogs, manuals, or PDF documents uploaded by the distributor to train their AI agent.

google.title: 2. Google User Data (Limited Use Policy)
google.content: EnpiAI requests access to your Google Calendar to allow your AI agents to schedule appointments and wellness checks on your behalf with prior consent.
google.disclosure: EnpiAI's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any other app will adhere to Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

use.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
use.content: We use the collected data to:
use.item1: Provide, operate, and maintain the EnpiAI platform and its business tools.
use.item2: Enable your AI agent to respond to customer and prospect inquiries in a personalized manner using the knowledge base indexed in Pinecone.
use.item3: Process and generate physical wellness diagnostics, BMI calculations, and nutrition plans suggested by AI.
use.item4: Automate appointment scheduling in your Google Calendar and send notifications of captured leads.
use.item5: Improve AI models and ensure overall system stability.

sovereignty.title: 4. Data Sovereignty, Encryption, and Security
sovereignty.content: EnpiAI follows a strict Data Sovereignty principle. All personally identifiable information (PII) and health data are stored in our relational database in encrypted form at the application level using military-grade Fernet encryption. The data is logically isolated per tenant (multi-tenant). We do not commercialize or share conversation histories or prospect lists with third parties.

thirdParty.title: 5. Third-Party Services and Transfers
thirdParty.content: Our platform interacts with essential external services: OpenAI/Google Gemini (natural language processing), Pinecone (vector database for RAG), WhatsApp (via our local Node.js gateway based on Baileys), and PayPal (secure billing processing). The interaction and transfer of data to these platforms comply exclusively with the functional purposes of the contracted service.

contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or the handling of your data, you can contact us at support@weblifetech.com

terms.intro: By using the EnpiAI platform, you agree to the following terms and conditions of service. Please read them carefully before starting.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing, registering, or using EnpiAI ('the Platform'), you agree to comply with and be bound by these terms and conditions. If you do not agree to any part of these terms, you must not use the Platform.

service.title: 2. Description of Service and Affiliation Disclaimer
service.content: EnpiAI is a SaaS ecosystem that provides intelligent conversational assistants, CRM, and health evaluation tools for independent Herbalife distributors. EnpiAI is an independent brand and development by WEBLIFETECH. We have no legal relationship, sponsorship, or commercial affiliation with Herbalife International, Herbalife Nutrition, or their subsidiaries. The use of the platform is the sole responsibility of the independent distributor.

responsibility.title: 3. Responsible Use and Communication Channels
responsibility.content: You agree to use the AI agents, WhatsApp integration, and communication capabilities exclusively for legitimate and lawful business purposes. You are responsible for:
responsibility.item1: The data, catalogs, and product documents uploaded to the AI agent's knowledge base (RAG), ensuring they do not infringe copyright or present false information.
responsibility.item2: Compliance with telecommunications laws and anti-spam regulations. You must not use the WhatsApp or Telegram gateway to send unsolicited bulk messages (spam) or harass users.
responsibility.item3: Ensuring that you have the consent of your clients/prospects before registering their health data in the CRM or sending them automated messages.

payments.title: 4. Payments, Subscriptions, and Credits
payments.content: Access to the full features of EnpiAI requires an active subscription or the purchase of conversation credit blocks. Payments are securely processed through PayPal Smart Buttons. Monthly recurring subscriptions require the customer to create a PayPal password during checkout due to gateway fraud policies and to allow control of recurring charges. One-time credit blocks support the Guest Checkout method. The backend performs instant server-to-server verification to activate your services immediately.

liability.title: 5. Limitation of Liability and Exclusions
liability.content: EnpiAI provides answers generated by Artificial Intelligence and automated evaluations based on user inputs. The wellness and BMI evaluations generated by the AI are for informational and general guidance purposes only; they do not constitute medical advice, clinical diagnoses, or medical treatment plans. Although we strive for maximum accuracy, EnpiAI is not responsible for AI hallucinations, errors, or omissions in the agent's responses, or for the misuse of health information. The distributor must monitor and adjust the knowledge base and agent behavior on an ongoing basis.

refunds.title: Refund Policy
refunds.p1: At EnpiAI (developed by WEBLIFETECH), we aim for our tools to fully optimize your nutrition and wellness business. Because real-time conversation processing consumes direct computing resources and AI API inference costs, our refund policy is governed by the following clear rules.

section1.title: 1. Monthly Membership Subscriptions
section1.p1: We offer a 14-day refund guarantee from the date of your first monthly subscription payment on the platform, subject to the following usage limits:
section1.li1: A 100% refund will be granted only if the accumulated conversation credit consumption on your account is less than 10% of the credits assigned in the contracted plan.
section1.li2: If the use of the AI assistant exceeds 10% of the monthly credits during this period, no full or partial refund can be made, due to the operational costs already incurred with LLM providers.

section2.title: 2. Additional Credit Blocks (Top-ups)
section2.p1: Independently purchased packages and additional credit blocks are non-refundable once their use has started (at least 1 credit has been consumed). If you purchased a block by mistake and have not had any conversation with it, you can request a full refund within 7 days of purchase.

section3.title: 3. Processing and Refund (PayPal)
section3.p1: All EnpiAI billing and subscriptions are securely managed through PayPal.
section3.p2: Once the refund request is approved by our team, the transaction will be automatically reversed through the PayPal API. The funds will be returned to the original credit/debit card or PayPal account within 5 to 10 business days, depending on your financial institution's policies.

section4.title: 4. How to Request a Refund
section4.p1: To request a refund, please send an email to support@weblifetech.com indicating the following details:
section4.li1: The email registered in your EnpiAI account.
section4.li2: The PayPal transaction ID or the subscription code sent in the purchase receipt.
section4.li3: The reason for your request (your feedback helps us improve the product and our agents' behavior).

refunds.footer: For any additional inquiries about consumption, limits, or cancellations, please feel free to write to us at support@weblifetech.com. We are here to support your business growth.
